bio: The clue is in the name: this restaurant is dedicated to Japanese food. The menu features not only sushi and sashimi, but also tempting dishes to share and items from the Konro grill; there is also an izakaya set menu. The taste and quality of the ingredients live up to expectations. The magnificent vaulted ceiling makes for a unique setting – with a chic and urban design and cosy atmosphere. You can steal glimpses of the chefs at work in the open kitchen at the entrance. The service is friendly and professional, and the chef is also present on the restaurant floor. A popular place that has many regulars. Chef Lukas Kienbauer has his fine dining restaurant right next door....
